verdict.rationale: Zulip documents a versioned API: a full changelog built on numbered API feature levels, which clients read from server responses to determine the API format and stay compatible across server versions. The pack contains no documented deprecation policy, such as notice periods, sunset timelines or deprecation markers, so only the versioning half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy and timelines, independent corroboration of versioning reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Every API change is logged under a numbered feature level (e.g. "Feature level 513" for Zulip 13.0), which clients read from server responses to determine the API format in use.
Zulip publishes a full API changelog built on its API feature levels system
